meta.name: web3-testing
meta.description: Test smart contracts comprehensively using Hardhat and Foundry with unit tests, integration tests, and mainnet forking. Use when testing Solidity contracts, setting up blockchain test suites, or validating DeFi protocols.

copy.tagline: 用主网分叉全面测试智能合约
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在发布去中心化金融协议前需要全面检查合约行为
copy.tagline_en: Test smart contracts thoroughly with mainnet forking
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build DeFi protocols and need automated contract tests before launch.

howto.what: Claude 会用 Hardhat 和 Foundry 为你的智能合约写测试：单元测试、集成测试、主网分叉、模糊测试，以及 Gas 消耗和测试覆盖率报告。
howto.when: 当你在测试 Solidity 合约、搭建区块链测试套件，或验证 DeFi 协议时，它会接管。

say.text: 用 Hardhat 给我的 Token 合约写单元测试，包含转账和事件断言。
say.note: 会用 loadFixture 搭测试环境并写出用例。

say.text: 用 Foundry 给转账函数写模糊测试，覆盖金额边界。
say.note: 会生成 testFuzz 用例和 vm.assume 约束。

say.text: 分叉主网，测试我的合约与 Uniswap 路由的交互。
say.note: 会配置 blockNumber 并连上主网合约地址。

howto.what_en: Claude writes smart contract tests with Hardhat and Foundry: unit and integration tests, mainnet forking, fuzzing, gas usage and coverage reports.
howto.when_en: Use it when you are testing Solidity contracts, setting up blockchain test suites, or validating DeFi protocols.

say_en.text: Write Hardhat unit tests for my Token contract, covering transfers and events.
say_en.note: Sets up a loadFixture test harness and writes the cases.

say_en.text: Write a Foundry fuzz test for the transfer function, covering amount bounds.
say_en.note: Generates a testFuzz case with vm.assume bounds.

say_en.text: Fork mainnet and test how my contract interacts with the Uniswap router.
say_en.note: Configures a blockNumber fork and connects mainnet contracts.
